gloss: to read and compare; to compare by reading

definitions.gloss: to read and compare; to read several texts side by side
definitions.explanation: To read two or more texts (articles, books, drafts, translations) in order to compare them. The objects compared are typically marked with を or と.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{比|くら}べる。
⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{比|くら}べてみた。
examples.english: I read the translation and the original side by side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各社|かくしゃ}→各社：11057_kakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{比|くら}べる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{切|き}り{口|くち}→切り口：22311_kirikuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: When you read and compare the articles from each company, you can clearly see that the angles differ even on the same incident.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) + ⟦{比|くら}べる→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧ (to compare).

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The texts being compared are marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧; for explicit pairing, use ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{比|くら}べる: read and compare newspapers
- ⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{比|くら}べる: compare translations
- ⟦{原文|げんぶん}→原文：20563_genbun⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{訳文|やくぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{比|くら}べる: compare the original and the translation

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS WITH 〜{比|くら}べる:
- {見|み}{比|くら}べる: look at and compare (visually)
- {聞|き}き{比|くら}べる: listen to and compare (audio)
- {食|た}べ{比|くら}べる: taste and compare (food)
